description: This file defines API route handlers for CRUD operations (GET, PATCH, DELETE) on individual blog post resources, based on an ID parameter. It manages database connection, validation, and returns JSON responses accordingly.

methods.name: export async function GET(_req: Request, context: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) { GET
methods.description: Fetches a single post document by ID from the database, handling invalid ID format and not found cases.

methods.name: export async function PATCH(req: Request, context: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) { PATCH
methods.description: Parcels and validates request body, updates an existing post document by ID, and returns the updated document or appropriate errors.

methods.name: export async function DELETE(_req: Request, context: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) { DELETE
methods.description: Deletes a post document by ID and returns 204 No Content upon success, handling invalid ID and not found cases.
